english.title: Damage / disturb site of special scientific interest
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, intentionally or recklessly

(A)_[destroyed or damaged flora]_
(B)_[destroyed or damaged geological features]_
(C)_[destroyed or damaged physiographical features]_
(D)_[destroyed, damaged or disturbed fauna]_

by reason of which a site, namely **(..SPECIFY SITE..), was a site of special scientific interest, and knowing that what was destroyed, damaged or disturbed was within such a site
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28P(6) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 28P(7) for "reasonable excuse".
(ii) As inserted by paragraph 1 of Schedule 9 to the Countryside and Rights of Way Act 2000.
(iii) Section 28P(10) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 provides that proceedings in England and Wales for an offence under Section 28P shall not, without the consent of the DPP, be taken by a person other than English Nature or the Natural Resources Body for Wales.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Difrodi / ymyrryd â safle o ddiddordeb gwyddonol arbennig
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), heb esgus rhesymol, bu ichi'n fwriadol neu'n fyrbwyll,

(A)_[ddinistrio neu ddifrodi planhigion]
(B)_[ddinistrio neu ddifrodi nodweddion daearegol]_
(C)_[ddinistrio neu ddifrodi nodweddion ffisiograffigol]_
(D)_[ddinistrio, difrodi neu aflonyddu ar anifeiliaid]_

drwy reswm, sef bod safle, sef **(..SPECIFY SITE..), yn safle o ddiddordeb gwyddonol arbennig, gan wybod fod yr hyn a ddinistriwyd, difrodwyd neu a aflonyddwyd arno o fewn safle o'r fath.
welsh.welshlegislation: Yn groes i adran 28P(6) Deddf Bywyd Gwyllt a Chefn Gwlad 1981

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding £20,000 (twenty thousand pounds)
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
